name: Graham Munro
headline: Sr Director of Partnerships & Alliances @ KIBO | Driving Partner Sales Success

experiences.description:
As an ecosystem leader for SAP’s partner program, I’m responsible for managing a select group of top performing SAP Customer Experience GSI partners, regional partners, and ISV partners to drive cloud software license revenue. This role is sales focused, working in strategic alignment with the regional CRO, market unit VP’s and the various account stakeholder's. KPI’s are partner co-originated pipeline & bookings, partner influenced bookings, indirect revenue bookings & ISV bookings. 

Aligned Success:
• 2021 Performance Award - Field Engagement Director of the Year
• 2020 SAP North America, Line of Business of the Year
• 2020 SAP North America, Line of Business of the Quarter, Q4
• 2020 Midmarket Region of the Year, NA
• 2020 Runner Up - Customer Experience North America Market Unit of the Year
• 2019 Customer Experience North American Market Unit of the Year
• 2019 Awarded and recognized as the #1 performer on the SAP Customer Experience Channel team

Working with leading SAP Customer Experience strategic channel partners, solution extension partners, & App center partners to drive cloud software license revenue and ensure mutual success. 

Aligned Success:
• 2019 SAP Customer Experience Partner Excellence Award - North America
• 2018 SAP Hybris ISV / Solex Partner of the Year
• 2018 SAP Hybris Americas Service Delivery Partner of the Year
• 2018 SAP Hybris EMEA Regional Partner of the Year

Responsible for partner recruitment, on-boarding, enablement, marketing, business management and success of a select group of SAP Hybris implementation and solution extension partners. 

Aligned Partner Success:
• 2017 SAP Hybris Global Newcomer Partner of the Year 
• 2017 SAP Hybris Americas Service Delivery Partner of the Year
• 2015 Account Representative of the Year, North America

• Lead a team of 7 Customer Service Representatives and 3 Financial Service Managers
• In fiscal 2012, earned the Top Ranking Branch Award in British Columbia: Ranking is based on Revenue, Sales, Net Promoter Score and Closed referrals to Private Client Group

• Reporting to the Executive VP of Sales, lead a team of Inside Sales Representatives
• Accountable for management and growth of the sales funnel in North America and Europe
• Notable wins included: Symantec, Cort, Blackberry, Virgin Media, Motability, Lulu, Benjamin Moore, OTE, Dufry, Wolters Kluwer

• Two time Presidents Club attendee for the top sales performers in the country
• Responsible for net new and existing customer sales, with a focus on expanding the product line footprint
• Negotiated and closed over $2 million dollars in lease & sales contracts over 5 years: 50% being net new business.
